description: Team GWIN is a team of four from Bahrain. We built Luna: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, a free 3D browser game where players aged 7–12 explore the Moon and Mars and make the calls that keep their crew alive. Real NASA data drives the game: DONKI space weather, real asteroids and real gravity. Our skills: AI-assisted coding, game design, science research and storytelling. We'd welcome teammates who love coding, 3D design, motion graphics, animation or physics.
